text: stick a completeness check in here at the document review
why_ambiguous: No directional cue — the check could defensibly sit on either side of the anchor task.

text: we need a QA step at this point in the flow
why_ambiguous: 'At this point' names the position but not which side of the anchor the step goes.

text: give the review a hard deadline
why_ambiguous: An interrupting deadline can be expressed as a raw boundary guard or as the packaged interrupting-timeout production — same observable effect.

text: this can't sit open forever — time-box it to two business days
why_ambiguous: A time-box that cuts the work off maps equally to attaching an interrupting guard or applying the timeout production.

text: keep nudging J. Smith every day until this clears
why_ambiguous: A repeating nudge with no mention of what happens on exhaustion fits a bare re-arming guard or the reminder-then-escalate production equally.

text: ping ops daily while this is in flight, without pausing the work
why_ambiguous: A scheduled non-interrupting fire alongside the task reads as either a re-arming guard or the notification production.

text: have it send a chase to the client every couple of days while the review runs
why_ambiguous: A recurring chase without an explicit exhaustion outcome could be the reminder cycle or a scheduled notification.

text: after the review, go straight to sanctions screening
why_ambiguous: Unclear whether a screening node already exists to wire to or a new one must be inserted downstream.

text: then solicit the outstanding evidence from the client
why_ambiguous: Soliciting evidence could be a bare send step added after the anchor or the full request-and-wait pattern.

text: branch out here into the additional verifications
why_ambiguous: Nothing says whether every verification always runs (parallel) or only the applicable ones (inclusive).

text: put a timer on the document review
why_ambiguous: A boundary timer is legal in both interrupting and re-arming form and the utterance names neither.

text: add an audit log entry at the chase step
why_ambiguous: The log entry plausibly belongs on either side of the chase and no ordering is given.

text: if nothing happens in a week, kill the chase
why_ambiguous: An interrupting one-week cut-off is expressible as an added interrupting guard or as the timeout production wrapping the task.

text: set the reminder to 5
why_ambiguous: Five could be the cycle bound on the trigger or the failure budget — the number carries no unit.

text: cap this at three
why_ambiguous: A cap of three reads as either the bounded-cycle maximum on the trigger or an override of the failure budget.

text: dial g_reminder back — no more than twice
why_ambiguous: 'No more than twice' fits both the cycle count and the budget, and the guard exposes both knobs.

text: this should be waiting on something else
why_ambiguous: Could mean swap the wait node for a different one or rekey the existing wait's correlation source.

text: ask for the documents before we sit here waiting for them
why_ambiguous: Adding a solicitation ahead of the wait versus restructuring into the request-and-wait pattern are both faithful readings.

text: add a receipt acknowledgement at this wait
why_ambiguous: An acknowledgement step could precede or follow the wait and the utterance gives no side.

text: put a four-eyes sign-off next to the evidence review
why_ambiguous: 'Next to' places the sign-off adjacent without saying before or after.

text: the client notice ought to get an answer back from them
why_ambiguous: Expecting a response could mean inserting a wait after the send or recasting it as request-and-wait.

text: drop an audit entry in at the notification step
why_ambiguous: The audit entry sits at the send task but neither side is specified.

text: route rejections over to the remediation step
why_ambiguous: If remediation already exists this is wiring an edge; if not it is a new outgoing branch — the utterance settles neither.

text: the outcome decision needs a data completeness check beside it
why_ambiguous: 'Beside' the gateway leaves open whether the check runs before routing or on the far side of it.

text: add a tally step at the per-document loop
why_ambiguous: A tally could seed the loop or summarize it — position relative to the MI node is unstated.

text: first thing, get the onboarding pack from the client
why_ambiguous: Getting the pack could be a single outreach task after Start or the full send-then-await-response pattern.

text: the close-out here should be a notification to the client
why_ambiguous: Making the finale a notification reads as inserting it ahead of End or as swapping the terminal node itself.

text: put a timer on the sanctions screen
why_ambiguous: The timer's interrupting versus re-arming character is unstated and both attachments are boarded here.

text: the sanctions screen gets a cut-off of one day
why_ambiguous: A one-day interrupting cut-off is equally an attached guard or the interrupting-timeout production.
